Company Description

For decades, Saatchi & Saatchi Health has provided consumer and professional marketing, strategic consulting, and medical education to pharmaceutical and wellness brands. Our mission is to inspire a healthier, happier, well-er world through award-winning work.

If you google us (which you may have done already), you’ll see that spreading wellness is literally our mission. We don’t just talk about making your well-being the most important thing, we mean it. Having a flexible hybrid-work policy, plentiful time off, and colleagues who want you to do well are all part of the gig. Oh, and of course the opportunity to work on some of the good-vibiest campaigns on the planet with very caring, very resourceful people.

So, if you’re a rockstar writer, aspiring strategist, jill—or jack—of all trades, or just an all-around nice person, let’s chat.

Overview

Saatchi & Saatchi Health is looking for a versatile digital Designer with graphics, animation, and video editing skills to join our team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for bringing visual art and content to life in an agency specifically built for speed, getting content to viewers at the speed of relevance.

The right person for this role will love to make eye-catching digital graphics and visual stories, create multiple iterations of animation and video elements, is always on the look-out for new visual trends, and is highly skilled in the tools they need to create polished deliverables for use across digital and social channels. If you’re entrepreneurial, a self-starter, and want an opportunity to work on an iconic household brand, see below and apply.

- Collaborate with cross-functional brand team members to ensure projects are accurately tracking through completion
- Bring designs to life by applying brand guidelines and creative briefs to transform pre-designed assets, storyboards, and content into cohesive, visual directions that support concept development
- Apply AI to energize your design workflow by sparking visual ideas, exploring variations, refining early directions, and supporting documentation while building strong personal taste, judgement, and originality

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, digital media, visual arts, or a related field
- 1+ years of experience in digital design or a related field
- A portfolio demonstrating solid fundamentals in digital design, including a clear understanding of typography, layout, and what works well visually

title: Assistant Designer, Footwear (LTD)
description:
Position Overview

At adidas, we never launch a product unless we consider it perfect.

As an Assistant Designer, Footwear, you will contribute to the creation of market relevant footwear within the adidas Originals category. This limited term position will support the design process from concept through execution while helping bring compelling product ideas to life that align with brand standards and consumer expectations.

You will play an important role in delivering commercially successful products by translating trends, consumer insights, and creative direction into tangible design solutions. Your work will support product storytelling, visualization, and technical execution while helping ensure consistency throughout the product creation process.

Working closely with designers, developers, marketers, and other cross functional partners, you will help transform ideas into prototypes and finished products. Your creativity, attention to detail, and collaborative mindset will contribute to seasonal product creation and strengthen the overall design direction within adidas Originals.

This limited term position is expected to continue through December 31, 2026.

Key Responsibilities

Footwear Design Execution: Design and co-design footwear concepts that align with business objectives, consumer insights, and seasonal product strategies.

Concept Visualization: Translate creative ideas into compelling visual concepts that support franchise storytelling and product direction.

Design Presentation: Communicate design concepts, product details, and creative rationale through presentations, reviews, and collaborative discussions.

Brand Alignment: Execute designs that reflect adidas design principles, visual language, and brand identity standards.

2D and 3D Design: Develop sketches, renderings, mockups, and digital models that support product visualization, refinement, and decision making.

Technical Documentation: Prepare accurate design specifications and complete tech packs for development teams to support prototype creation.

Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, development, and product creation teams to ensure alignment from concept through execution.

Trend Research: Monitor consumer, cultural, fashion, and industry trends to inspire innovative product concepts and support future design direction.

-  Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced and collaborative environment.

title: Product Designer
description:
About Luma

Luma’s mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world.

We believe that multimodality is critical for intelligence. To go beyond language models and build more aware, capable and useful systems, the next step function change will come from vision. So, we are working on training and scaling up multimodal foundation models for systems that can see and understand, show and explain, and eventually interact with our world to effect change.

Where You Come In

We are looking for a hands-on generalist with impeccable taste and a strong, opinionated design perspective. This is not a role for hyper-specialists or managers. You will take ownership of projects and drive the design vision from a fuzzy concept to a polished, shipped feature with a high degree of autonomy. You will tackle the unique challenge of designing novel, intuitive interaction paradigms for an AI-native product, making abstract concepts feel tangible and magical.

We are open to both full-time and contract-to-hire candidates, depending on experience, mutual fit, and team needs.

At Luma, AI is not a feature we design around. It is how we work. We expect designers to think with AI, generate with AI, build with AI, and use it to accelerate everything from ideation to production. If you have already made this shift in how you work, you will thrive here.

What You'll Do



- Own features end-to-end. Lead the design process for major features, from initial product thinking and user exploration to pixel-perfect visual design and high-fidelity interactive prototypes.
- Design novel interactions. Go beyond static screens. Design and prototype fluid, novel interactions for a new medium, taking complex AI concepts and making them feel intuitive and powerful.
- Build functional prototypes with AI. Use AI coding tools to create working prototypes and shippable features, working in close collaboration with engineering. We value designers who can make real things, not just mockups.
- Uphold a high bar for craft. Create exceptionally high-quality visual designs, interactions, and prototypes, demonstrating world-class taste and an obsession with detail.
- Drive work forward through ambiguity. Operate effectively in a fast-paced startup environment where direction is not always clear. Step into problems before being asked, make decisions with incomplete information, and push work forward independently.
- Collaborate across disciplines. Work closely with engineers, product, and AI researchers to explore new use cases, shape product strategy, and ensure the design vision ships at high quality. Design at Luma is not a solo discipline. Outcomes are built across teams.

Who You Are



- You have 5+ years of experience building delightful and innovative products at scale.
- You are equally strong in craft and product thinking. You demonstrate excellence across visual design, interaction design, and product thinking.

title: UI/UX Product Designer
description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Movement changes lives — and for nearly 50 years, Balanced Body has led the world in Pilates equipment and education, pairing mindful movement with world-class engineering. From our solar-powered headquarters in Sacramento, we manufacture premium equipment that helps people feel better and move more freely

We're growing our marketing team and looking for a creative, sharp, strategically-minded UI/UX Product Designer to help shape how people experience Balanced Body online.

A note on the role: this is a design role first and foremost — not software development. You'll own the end-to-end visual and interactive design of our digital products, from user research and wireframing through high-fidelity prototypes. You'll also handle final front-end implementation and visual customization in our CMS platforms (WordPress and Shopify) — but you won't be writing backend code.

- Continuous UX Research — Run ongoing user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to keep our platforms grounded in UX best practice.
- Cross-Functional Balancing — Act as creative consultant across marketing, development, and SEO — making agile adjustments without compromising design integrity.
- Visual Asset Creation — Produce polished marketing assets: banners, icons, UI components, and promotional graphics.

Requirements

- Experience: 5+ years in a dedicated UI/UX or Product Design role, comfortable owning timelines and major deliverables independently.
- Education: Bachelor's in a design field (Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Graphic Design, HCI) preferred; equivalent experience considered.
- Portfolio: End-to-end product thinking — UX workflows, interaction design, responsive structures, and refined final execution. A trained eye for type, color, and hierarchy is a must.

title: Product Designer

About Your Role 👀

As the second Product Designer at Pogo, you'll help lead the product design and creative direction for our new consumer insights product, which allows brands/retailers to connect with millions of purchase-verified consumers. This platform will ultimately be used by some of the largest companies in the world.

Specifically, you will:



- Design core product experiences end-to-end, from early exploration through launch and iteration for our up-and-coming B2B platform and consumer app with 3 million users (and growing)
- Craft polished, delightful interfaces that build trust and showcase the power of our data and AI technology
- Sweat the details - layout, typography, spacing, color, motion, interactions
- Help define the product roadmap and lay the foundations for our design language, systems, and culture. 
- Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, startup environment
- Be 1 of 2 designers (for now), working cross-functionally with engineering and GTM

About You 👩‍🚀



- Experience designing software products. 
- Bonus if you’ve done this at a startup, or have designed AI interactions before!
- Bonus if you have experience designing enterprise-grade products. 
- You design quickly and efficiently, using Figma to gain super powers and reach “escape velocity design”. When needed, you make near-term tradeoffs and take shortcuts - even though you have strong design vision and awareness of how to improve the product later. 
- You’re a design nerd at heart. You have a very high bar for design quality and strong opinions about what “great” looks like. - You’re a full-stack designer. You've designed experiences from scratch and know how to bring it to life working cross-functionally with product and engineering. 
- You have strong product intuition and have a knack for creating experiences that index on simplicity and clarity. At the same time, you're willing to re-consider your initial intuition as you get more user data. 

Why you might be excited about this opportunity 🙌



- Work on the design for an up-and-coming enterprise product. Our enterprise demand is growing, and we are in the early stages of building a product that will ultimately be used by some of the largest companies in the world. You’ll use qualitative interviews and direct customer feedback to shape product decisions and design solutions tailored to enterprise needs. 
- Design matters a lot to us.

At Armadin, we're a group of engineers, researchers, and hackers on a mission to redefine what proactive security can do in the AI era. Cyberattacks are becoming autonomous and relentless and we believe defending against threats before they materialize is one of the most powerful ways to protect the institutions the world depends on.


We're building autonomous proactive security from the ground up, reinforcing the tradecraft of elite red teamers into purpose-built security models and agents that discover risk and remediate it before organizations are breached.

In-person in our Palo Alto office.

title: Product Designer
description:
About The Role

We're looking for a product designer who wants to operate like a founder.

Not someone who waits for tickets or perfect requirements. Someone who sees opportunities, prototypes fast, shapes product direction, and ships experiences that move the company forward.

This is not a "make the UI pretty" role. You'll work across product thinking, interaction design, systems, prototyping, and execution. In many cases, you'll go from idea → prototype → shipped product in days, not quarters.

The best people for this role think strategically, build relentlessly, and use AI as leverage.

Why This Role Is Different

The role of design is changing.

AI has collapsed the distance between idea and execution. The best designers today don't just create mockups, they can explore product directions, prototype interactions, generate working interfaces, and pressure-test ideas themselves.

We Believe The Future Belongs To Designers Who



- Think like product leaders
- Prototype like engineers
- Use AI tools fluently
- Care about outcomes, not deliverables
- Move from ambiguity to shipped product with very little overhead

If that excites you, you'll probably love working here.

What You'll Work On



- Own product areas end-to-end, from initial insight to shipped experience
- Lead greenfield explorations and turn blank-canvas ideas into real products
- Prototype aggressively, in code, AI tools, Figma, or whatever gets the idea across fastest
- Work directly with engineers and PMs to shape product direction, not just execution
- Think deeply about systems, workflows, and how features compound across the platform
- Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to increase speed, creativity, and iteration velocity
- Raise the quality bar across the company through strong product judgment and craft
- Push ideas into reality quickly instead of over-optimizing in planning phases

How We Work



- We optimize for speed of learning and iteration
- We prototype early instead of debating endlessly
- We use AI heavily across design, product thinking, research, and engineering
- We believe small, high-agency teams can outperform much larger organizations
- We believe the best builders in the AI era are token maxxers, people who use AI relentlessly to compress execution cycles, test ideas faster, and expand the scope of what a single person can accomplish
- We care more about shipping and learning than rigid role boundaries

What We're Looking For



- 3–6 years of product design experience, ideally at startups or highly product-driven teams
- A strong track record of owning products or features from concept through launch
- High agency. You naturally move things forward without waiting for direction
- Strong product instincts and clear opinions about what should exist and why
- Excellent visual and interaction design skills, grounded in systems thinking
- Comfort operating in ambiguity and figuring things out in real time
- Bias toward building and prototyping over

At Bumble, we’re on a mission to create a world where healthy relationships are built on respect and equality. The Bumble Date Design team brings that mission to life by shaping how millions of people experience connection across every touchpoint.

As a Product Designer focused on our flagship Date product, you’ll help reimagine what modern dating can feel like: safe, joyful, intuitive, and deeply human. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, User Researchers, and fellow designers, you’ll create thoughtful experiences that empower people to build meaningful relationships with confidence.

You’ll join a team that champions craft, collaboration, and continuous learning. We value designers who combine empathy with product thinking, embrace curiosity, and use AI responsibly to accelerate exploration while keeping human needs at the centre of every decision. title: Product Designer
description:
About Sol

Sol is an agentic HR system built for how work is changing. We're replacing the traditional HRIS with an AI-native foundation. We are built for change, designed to scale, and reimagined with AI from the ground up, so HR leaders get a clear view of their workforce instead of a system everyone works around.

Sol was founded by leaders who spent decades building the modern HR category, and is backed by Sutter Hill Ventures and NEA. Our first customers go live in early 2027 and we need you to make them wildly successful.

The Role

We're hiring our first Product Designer. This is a rare opportunity to define the experience layer of a platform that spans everyone from an employee who should never have to log into a portal, to a Chief People Officer managing compliance across a dozen countries.

The core premise: great design in an agentic world means the system meets people where they are. For an employee, that's a simple chat that resolves their question without creating a ticket. For an HR admin, it's a configuration experience that handles deep complexity without feeling complicated. For a manager, it's the right signal at the right moment.

And there's a layer on top of all of this: our customers don't just use Sol, they define their own experiences. They configure their own agents, shape workflows to fit how their organization works, and make the platform theirs. That means you're not just designing for end users. You're building the tools that allow customers to shape their own systems. Getting that right, the configuration experience, the guardrails, the language customers work within, is one of the hardest and most interesting challenges in enterprise software.

You will shape all of it.

What You'll Do



- Define the design vision and system for Sol — across employee-facing interactions, HR admin workflows, manager experiences, and leadership views
- Design for an agent-first world: think conversationally, contextually, and across surfaces — from simple chat threads to deeply configurable workflows
- Design the platform's builder layer — the experiences that allow customers to define their own agents, flows, and interfaces on top of Sol
- Establish and steward a design system that scales from zero-friction employee moments to the most complex compliance and configuration scenarios
- Exercise strong judgment across surfaces — knowing when an interaction belongs in Sol vs. a place-of-work system, and what the agent should do vs. surface
- Work directly with early customers to understand how HR, managers, finance, and employees experience the system today — and what they'll expect tomorrow
- Partner closely with product and engineering to translate domain complexity into experiences that feel simple and inevitable

What We're Looking For



- You've designed for enterprise software — real complexity, organizational scale, and diverse user types are table stakes to you, not surprises
- You've worked across a spectrum of users within t

title: Product Designer
description:
About Us

At Roadrunner, we’re replacing the broken CPQ software that Sales teams have complained about, worked around, and given up on for years. Not improving it - replacing it. We’re building a new agentic stack called PQA - Prompt, Quote, Approve, designed for the enterprise, on a data model built for how pricing actually works today.

We’re Kleiner Perkins’ first incubation since Glean, led by second-time founders with successful exits, and a team of engineers from Snowflake, Databricks, Citadel, Meta, Robinhood, Brex, and so on. We’re in-person in San Francisco, and we’re just getting started.

What You’ll Do



- Set the tone for how the product looks and feels. You'll curate the taste of the product — every interaction, layout, and detail should feel intentional. 
- Turn hard problems into UI that just works. CPQ is full of complex workflows and dense data — you'll make them feel simple without hiding the complexity users actually need. 
- Work directly with engineers and the people using what you build. You'll be embedded with engineers on dedicated workstreams, making decisions in real time. Get feedback fast, iterate faster. 
- Design with AI tools, for AI-native workflows. You'll shape how users interact with and trust AI agents, and use AI in your own process to move fast. 
- Build an airtight design system. You'll evolve our design system so you and engineers can ship consistent UI at speed. 

Example projects



- Designing a quoting experience that lets AEs configure complex multi-product deals in minutes instead of hours. 
- Defining the visual language and component patterns for approval workflows that handle multibillion-dollar transactions — where clarity isn't a nice-to-have, it's a requirement. 
- Evolving our design system to support new product surfaces while keeping the token architecture clean and the component library tight. 

What You’ll Bring



- Systems thinking. You see patterns across screens and build for reuse, not one-offs. 
- High autonomy and a builder's mindset — you figure out what needs to be designed and do it. 
- Experience designing with AI tools to move faster without sacrificing quality. 
- Clear, direct communication with engineers and founders. You can articulate why a design works, not just what it looks like. 
- Based in SF or excited to relocate — we're an in-person team. 

Bonus points if…



- Strong visual chops — you sweat the details on layout, typography, color, and spacing
- Frontend-aware and have shipped a PR. 
- Experience designing complex B2B/SaaS workflows, especially with AI-powered features where trust and user control matter. 
- You've been at an early-stage company and know what full ownership of design actually feels like. 

What we offer



- Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family. 
- Lunch and dinner, as well as snacks and coffee to keep you energized. 
- Take what you need vacation policy.

title: Product Designer III
description:
This is a hybrid position onsite are our corporate office in downtown Milwaukee. M, T, W are required onsite days. 

About The Job

The Product Designer delivers impactful, innovative, user-centered design solutions employing an iterative, evidence based design-process.

What You'll Do



- Analyze complex features and flows, balance user needs and business needs, and find solutions that make the complex feel simple.
- Lead the creation thoughtful journey maps, user flows, site-maps, wireframes, and prototypes.
- Follow an an iterative, evidence based design process, prototype, define experiments, and validate design ideas.
- Produce work that follows UX best practices, internal guidelines, and also brings fresh ideas to the table.

Overview

As a Product Designer at RealPage, you're at the frontline of the relationship between landlords and their renters. You are trying to create value for all parties as you build product via our user-centered methodology. You will represent Design in all steps of the product development lifecycle from product strategy through discovery, design, development, pilot, and general availability release. You are the UX side of the product-building triangle along with a product manager and a development lead. You will have experience collaboratively exploring the overlap between business and user goals. You have experience quantifying value creation, the delta between the current experience and the new experience. You excel at facilitating unbiased feedback to define and refine solutions. You are a champion for curiosity, and you also know how to narrow scope to something that can be released!

Responsibilities



- Use personas and a narrative to story-tell the problem to solve and its solution
- Extract requirements from customer pain points
- Lead user, customer, and SME interviews
- Clearly document knowledge, existing workflows, and pain points gained from user, customer, and SME interviews
- Synthesize discovery findings to narrow and prioritize into actionable scope
- Solve product/user problems utilizing user-centered design thinking
- Document the design solution's workflow and functional specifications for Engineering to build
- Suggest a range of solutions that solve the narrowed scope
- Sequence releases of proposed enhancements to help establish product timeline
- Determine and monitor success metrics for proposed work
- Lead team momentum through product design lifecycle, including developing a pilot plan and General Availability readiness plan to go to market with
- Work with PM to align on design solution and assist in discovery efforts with producing discussion guides and conducting SME interviews
- Work with engineers and QA to be able to communicate designed functionality and workflows for ticketing and quality control testing
- Utilize design standards system in designing a solution and work with Design Standards team to provide feedback on design system evolution
- Work with UX researchers in continuous discovery efforts
- Understanding how to establish success metrics to gauge adoption and solution validation
- Grow with RP Product Design Center of Excellence curriculum and be mentored by senior product designers

Qualifications



- Passing completion of UX coursework (degrees, certificates, bootcamps, online courses accepted)
- Portfolio must tell human stories, demonstrate ability to define and assess user problems, show the work of problem-solving, communicate design solution with low-fidelity wireframes and high-fidelity clickable prototype, possess metrics of success for user outcomes, and demonstrate ability to assemble release strategy for product enhancements
- Minimum 4 years of experience with UX, design, architect

The Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) team plays a pivotal role in Affirm’s mission, building products that establish direct and lasting relationships with our customers. Our App and Card experiences empower people with transparent financing options wherever they need them, helping them make informed financial decisions with confidence.

As a Staff Product Designer, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of consumer finance at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey. We’re hiring a Product Designer to support People Innovation Labs, a fast-moving engineering team embedded in the People organization focused on rethinking how we find and retain the best talent and empower everyone to do their best work.

The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200B annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them.

At North, we’re building the next-generation cloud spend management platform. We give companies real-time visibility, control, and automation over their cloud finances, so they can grow efficiently, without wasting time or money.

Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global customers like Brave, The New York Public Library, and SumUp, we’re assembling a world-class team to redefine how businesses manage cloud infrastructure.

We’re hiring a Product Designer to own end-to-end UI/UX across our platform. You’ll lead the design process from early discovery and wireframes to high-fidelity execution and production-ready specs.

This is a role for someone who lives in Figma, thinks in systems, and cares deeply about crafting intuitive, elegant experiences for complex financial and technical workflows. Our product sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, and AI and your job is to make it feel simple.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and CEO to simplify cloud cost management, forecasting, and optimization , translating dense FinOps concepts into intuitive, beautiful software used by technical and business stakeholders alike.

This is a high-ownership, 0→1 environment where design has real leverage.

- Partner closely with Engineering to ensure pixel-perfect implementation and thoughtful interaction design.
- Collaborate with Product to shape roadmap decisions through design thinking and user insight.
- Simplify dense workflows (commitments, cost allocation, anomaly detection, forecasting) into intuitive user journeys.
- Continuously improve usability through iteration, feedback loops, and experimentation.

- 5+ years of experience designing modern SaaS products (B2B preferred).
- Strong mastery of Figma (components, auto layout, variants, prototyping, design systems).
- Deep understanding of information architecture and interaction design.
- Experience designing for data-heavy or analytics-driven products.
- Ability to translate complex technical or financial concepts into intuitive UX.

title: Product Designer

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy in across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

title: Apprentice Product Designer
description:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The Pinterest Apprenticeship Program is an opportunity for professionals from non-tech backgrounds and those who may face barriers of entry into the industry to experience Product Design at Pinterest. Apprenticeships are up to one year long with the opportunity to be considered for conversion to a full-time Product Designer. Employment throughout the program is at will, and while programs can be up to one year in length, there is no guarantee on the specific length of the program.

Applications may close as early as Friday, July 10, 2026 at 5:00pm PDT. The program start date will be October 19, 2026.

What You’ll Do



- Work alongside other Pinterest Product Designers and key partners on our Research, Product Management, and Engineering teams on a high-impact project
- Learn about the design process, starting from ideation and exploration, all the way to executing and implementing with Engineering
- Collaborate with an assigned mentor who will help you navigate the expectations associated with being an Product Designer at Pinterest
- Leverage AI tools to optimize your workflow and to make cross-functional collaboration more productive and efficient

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Organization Overview

Lilly Catalyze360 is a comprehensive approach to enabling the early-stage biotech ecosystem by democratizing access to infrastructure, expertise, and resources. Through its interconnected pillars—Lilly Ventures, Lilly Gateway Labs, Lilly ExploR&D, and Lilly TuneLab—Catalyze360 strategically removes barriers that traditionally block bold science from becoming life-changing medicines, providing biotechs with flexible combinations of capital, physical lab space, R&D capabilities, AI/ML tools, and decades of enterprise learning.

Lilly TuneLab is an artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) platform that provides biotech companies access to drug discovery models trained on years of Lilly’s research data. Lilly estimates that this first release of AI models includes proprietary data obtained at a cost of over $1 billion, representing one of the industry’s most valuable datasets used to train an AI system available to biotechnology companies. Job Summary

TuneLab has powerful underlying AI models and point solutions. The job now is to turn them into something a biotech startup can actually use: a coherent workflow, a clean product experience, and a SaaS offering that scales.

We’re looking for a founding Product Designer to own how the product works and feels for external biotech partners. The primary focus is the problem space: who we’re building for, what they actually need, where existing tools fall short, and what’s worth building. The secondary focus is execution—including a design system that accelerates the team rather than becoming a project of its own.

At this stage, the biggest risk isn’t building too slowly. It’s building the wrong thing. Your job is to reduce that risk—live close to users, sharpen what’s worth building, and put design in front of engineering so we don’t commit resources to the wrong problems.

There’s no design org above you and no design system to inherit. You set the design bar. You’re the senior designer in the room.

About Codes Health

We’re fixing one of the most broken and crucial parts of plaintiff litigation: getting complete, accurate medical records. Today, that takes 30 to 50 days of faxing, calling, and portal-chasing across thousands of providers, each running its own back office.

We deliver records in ~12 days on average. To do this, we're building an agentic layer that operates in this messy, real-world environment. Every retrieval teaches our system how to access another corner of American healthcare, building a provider data layer you can't scrape or buy and putting us at the most upstream point of a $20B+ market where everything downstream depends on us.

This problem extends far beyond the plaintiff legal space. It's also pervasive in healthcare, where our CEO Alvaro first encountered it while running a home health agency, as well as in disability services, life sciences/clinical trials, and the insurance industry. All of these verticals face this same challenge.

“Codes isn’t just participating in the workflow; it’s capturing the moment where the most important data is created, positioning itself to expand from ingestion into orchestration and ultimately own the entire stack.” Amplify Partners, “Boring is Sexy”

We've gone from $0 to a $3M+ run rate in a year and grown 2.5x quarter over quarter for four straight quarters. We've raised $17M from Amplify, General Catalyst, Haystack, and Y Combinator. We serve 130+ law firms across plaintiff litigation and mass tort, including the largest plaintiff firm in the country.

The Work

Design is central to what we build. Our work is responsible for critical legal and medical workflows; the job is all about maximizing simplicity while minimizing loss of fidelity. Our customers do not care about the latest model update or extraction pipelines. They care about results: getting full information as quickly as possible. You'll be the one 'behind the curtain', modulating the experience between the two extremes.

You'll be our first designer, own design end to end, and ship fast with the founders. You are someone who likes to:



- Design across a large surface area with many different stakeholders. You will spend as much time on critical internal tools as you will customer facing product. 
- Simplify extremely large contexts. Medical records are comprised of messy, conflicting, scanned, duplicative, and largely faxed information, ingested thousands of pages at a time. 
- Design for scale. Customers run thousands of cases at once, so the product has to work just as well in aggregate as it does for individual cases. 
- Layer in AI as a tool, not an outcome. Every workflow should be facilitated or automated with AI, and the user should barely realize that it’s there. 
- Shape our design language and system from the ground up, within the context of our customers and industry.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

Nearly half of the U.S. workforce is hourly: healthcare workers, retail associates, manufacturing teams, restaurant staff, and more. These are the people who keep the world running, and serving them is one of Rippling’s largest and most important bets.

For hourly employees and their managers, mobile isn't a secondary surface — it's the surface. These employees aren't opening laptops. They're checking their schedule on a break, approving shift swaps from the parking lot, clocking out from their phone. If the mobile experience isn't excellent, the product fails for this entire customer segment.

This role owns the full Time mobile experience plus the Timeclock app, which means full ownership of two high-usage products. The design constraints are challenging: you need to be fast, clear, and compliant in a context where attention is minimal and stakes are high. Additionally, Rippling is making a deliberate push to bring AI-powered workflows to employees, not just admins, and Mobile is where that lands for hourly workers. Since Time is the biggest driver of Rippling app usage, the quality bar this person sets will raise our mobile standards across the board.

As a designer on this team, you will work on some of Rippling's most important product problems. You will define ambiguous opportunities, shape product direction, prototype deeply, and own outcomes end-to-end. Designers at Rippling are product builders, and AI is part of how we build: from early thinking to prototyping to what ships to customers.

- Design exceptional mobile-first product experiences for modern workforce management — including clock-in/out flows, schedule views, shift swaps, break tracking, timecard approvals, and the Timeclock kiosk app.

Join HARMAN’s Automotive Design Team in Novi, Michigan and help shape the future of premium in-car experiences for some of the world’s most recognized audio brands.

We are looking for a highly creative automotive experience designer who can craft emotionally engaging HMI systems, advanced touchscreen interactions, and visually sophisticated interfaces that bring our brands to life inside the vehicle.

You will create the digital face of premium automotive sound brands across OEM platforms — designing immersive experiences that combine interface design, sound interaction, motion, branding, and emerging technologies.

Working at the intersection of automotive HMI, premium branding, and future mobility, you will explore new interaction models beyond traditional lists and toggles, helping define next-generation sound experiences for millions of drivers worldwide.

This role combines high-level UX thinking with hands-on visual execution and production-ready delivery. You will collaborate with a global network of designers, developers, sound engineers, and OEM partners while maintaining strong creative ownership from concept to final integration.

If you are passionate about designing visually rich, highly polished, and emotionally resonant automotive experiences — this role offers a rare opportunity to shape products that will be publicly visible in production vehicles around the world.

What You Will Do

Design Premium Automotive Experiences



- Design visually stunning and emotionally engaging UX/UI experiences for branded automotive audio systems and sound features
- Create immersive touchscreen interfaces, interaction concepts, animations, and visual systems for in-car environments
- Develop innovative interaction models and explore alternative input mechanics beyond traditional automotive UI patterns
- Translate brand identity into highly polished digital experiences that feel premium, recognizable

title: Senior Design Lead
description:
Work & Co, part of Accenture Song, is a global design and technology company with offices in the United States, Europe, and Latin America. We're known for uniting the industry’s best hands-on strategy, product and technical talent to generate tangible impact at scale. Client partners include IKEA, Apple, PGA TOUR, Gatorade, Google, Mercedes, Givenchy, the MTA and more. As Fast Company noted, our engineering and design teams are routinely entrusted with creating digital products for companies which rarely approach outside firms. Forrester Research calls our approach “a model to follow.” Visit work.co to learn more.

Designers who thrive at Work & Co see no boundary between form and function. They are highly strategic, detail-oriented, and multi-skilled, bringing a deep understanding across visual design, user experience, user interface design, branding and even coding.

Creating digital products requires intense collaboration — internally, and with our clients. We believe in prototyping early and often. Our focus is on the end-user, conducting multiple rounds of testing to validate our concepts.

One big difference? Our partners are hands-on and you’ll work directly with them. There’s no middle management here. You’ll also work closely with Product Managers, Strategists, and Developers to create original digital products and services that reignite industries and reshape companies.

What You Will Do



- Stay 100% focused on making great digital products--that’s all we care about

- Participate in all project phases, from strategy to launch to optimization

- Portfolio or samples of work demonstrating digital product design

- Ability and desire to solve complex product design problems and the strategy skills to deliver best-in-class solutions

- Demonstrated ability to synthesize and present findings, and articulate design rationale 
- Experience working in a highly iterative, collaborative environment where people share work daily 
- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills 
- Familiarity with prototyping tools

description:
Let’s face it, a company whose mission is human transformation better have some fresh thinking about the employer/employee relationship.

Even our candidate experience is different. And when you get an offer from us (and accept it), you get way more than a paycheck. You get a personal BetterUp Coach, a development plan, a trained and coached manager, the most amazing team you’ve ever met (yes, each with their own personal BetterUp Coach), and most importantly, work that matters.

You’ll define how our design system leverages AI for implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement, positioning BetterUp at the forefront of AI-augmented product design.

- Anticipate industry shifts in design tooling and AI capabilities, positioning BetterUp to adopt them ahead of competitors

title: UX/UI Designer – Fleet Command & Robot Management
description:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects. 
 Position Overview
We’re building the command layer for a new generation of intelligent robots.
As our first UX/UI design hire, you will define how humans command, deploy, and collaborate with autonomous systems in the physical world. You will own the experience for fleet command of distributed, sensor-equipped robotic systems operating in real environments. This is mission-critical software that enables non-experts to operate intelligent machines, not a fleet dashboard with status icons. Customers will rely on what you design to monitor, deploy, coordinate, and intervene across their robot installations. 
Beyond fleet command, you will architect a radically simplified deployment experience: a true “unbox, power on, connect, deploy” journey via app or tablet. Our ambition is to eliminate heavy pilots and prolonged engagements by making robot activation intuitive, guided, and production-ready from day one.
This is a zero-to-one role with expanding scope. You will set the design standard for the company and establish deployment and command UX as a strategic advantage for Skild AI.Responsibilities

- Own UX/UI from concept through production.
- Translate complex robotics and AI capabilities into simplified, controllable systems.
- Design production workflows for distributed, moving, sensor-equipped assets.
- Lead customer interviews, usability studies, and rapidly prototyping.
- Raise the design craft, rigor, and systems-thinking bar across the applied AI team.
- End-to-end UX for fleet monitoring and control
- AI-assisted control surfaces (configure, automate, supervise, escalate)
- Self-service onboarding and training workflows
- Real-time telemetry and multimodal sensor visualization (camera + beyond)
- Alerting, incident response, and system health management
- Task orchestration and multi-robot coordinationPreferred Qualifications

- 2-4 years designing exceptional consumer hardware experiences and/or complex B2B operational systems.
- Proven experience building production workflows for distributed systems or moving assets.
- Strong background in data-heavy, real-time operational tools.
- Experience with monitoring, alerting, and multi-state workflows.
- Experience designing interfaces integrating multimodal data.
- Demonstrated systems thinking and high design craft.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Introduction

We value candidates who have significant experience with managing complexity, working independently, and are motivated by hard problems.

What We Offer



- The ability to have real impact on mission-critical workflows
- The chance to use state-of-the-art tech to solve novel problems with mission partners
- The opportunity to define your role through time as we grow
- Competitive salary and equity upside with annual merit refreshes based on impact

What You'll Do



- Build an AI-Native Design System: Build a scalable, React-based component-driven design system that engineers can and will use by default.
- Ensure the design system is directly consumable by AI tools (like Claude Code and Codex) rather than being siloed in Figma.
- Empower Engineering: Proactively educate the engineering team by showing them how to leverage the design system to make good, independent UI/UX choices.
- Introduce and lead rapid prototyping techniques to quickly gather feedback on early feature ideas before heavy engineering begins.
- Help review meaningful frontend changes for design concerns.
- Own the Design Process: Establish a new, scalable design process that matches our fast pace and takes design out of the bottleneck.
- Position product design as a proactive product owner that iterates on the platform without requiring direct hand-holding.
- Establish tight feedback loops with customer strategists and end-users to inform product direction and usability improvements.

Qualifications



- 3–5+ years of experience designing complex digital products, with a portfolio showing real shipped work, clear problem framing, and strong visual craft
- Design & Technical Hybrid: Strong grasp of user experience principles and frontend skills in React; comfortable opening a PR, tweaking TSX/CSS, or collaborating at a technical level with engineers
- Interaction Design & IA Skills: Ability to untangle dense, stateful workflows and make them feel obvious and intuitive
- Visual & Systems Design Instincts: Keen eye for typography, spacing, hierarchy, and motion that make a product feel cohesive
- Cross-Functional Partner: Operates as a true partner to engineering and product, not a downstream service
- Bias for Action & Autonomy: Spots design debt and fixes it systematically without waiting for permission; knows how to unblock others by creating scalable systems
- Design Tooling: Proficiency in Figma with comfort moving seamlessly between rapid exploration and high-fidelity, polished work
- Clear Communicator: Able to articulate design decisions clearly across audiences including customers, engineers, and operational stakeholders

Desired Qualifications



- AI Tool Fluency: Experience with AI-enabled prototyping and using tools like Claude to multiply output (e.g. translating code to canvas or setting up AI-friendly UI components)
- Complex Domains: Experience designing tools for logistics, operations, defense, healthcare, or other dense operational s

title: UX Product Designer - Encore Program
description:
Role Overview: As a UX Product Designer for the Deloitte DT-US Product Engineering team, you will be tasked with solving complex challenges through elegant, user-centered design solutions. Our ideal candidate is a versatile design generalist with deep expertise in interaction design. You should feel equally at home shaping big-picture workflow and strategy as you are prototyping details visual and interaction elements. This role requires a proven track-record of experience-driven innovation. Join us in shaping the future of design!

You are a user-centered design expert and will lead the creation of design strategy and vision, shaping big-picture workflow and product direction while also delivering high-quality visual and interaction design elements.

You have a deep understanding of lean UX approaches and working in small, empowered product teams to design & deliver impactful experiences. You will apply behavioral metrics, user research findings, and other data-driven insights to design innovative product solutions that delight our users and meet their needs. Join us in shaping the future of design!

Recruiting for this role ends on July 16, 2026

Work you'll do



-  Responsible and accountable for design and usability for a product or product area. Connects product to broader product experience vision.
-  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design engaging and intuitive user experiences using an iterative lean UX approach of continuous improvement
-  Leads teams in framing and solving hard experience problems; Drives innovative UX efforts that uncover new user value with new kinds of experiences. Conducts cross-functional workshops.
-  Bring your expertise in the Experience craft to the cross functional product team, think deeply about complex experience challenges, and propose effective and elegant solutions
-  Make strategic design and user-experience decisions related to core, and new, functions and features
-  Develop new approaches to complex design problems and convey these designs in the form of presentations, mockups, and click-thru prototypes that bring your vision to life
-  Create strategic big-picture workflows as well as execute detailed visual & interaction design
-  Partner with user researchers and influence insight studies related to the discovery and understanding of unresolved interface problems and product design opportunities
-  Design and deliver all UX assets including initial concept designs, user flows, wireframes, usage scenarios, user journeys, mockups, etc that support intuitive and seamless user interactions
-  Understand business priorities together with user needs to create impactful experiences
-  Collaborates with business stakeholders, engineering, product, and delivery to emerge solutions to achieve strategy objectives and KPI outcomes
-  Contribute to the overall design framework, ensuring consistent design language and experiences across the product suite, and a library of design assets for r

title: UX UI Designer
description:
Title

UX UI Designer

Job Description

HIRING: UX UI Designers (Multiple Levels and Opportunities)

At 4Insite, we are revolutionizing facilities management by empowering managers with a simple yet powerful software tool.

With a tool that is intuitive and designed by and for facilities management, we have dedicated industry experts to implement the app and deliver exceptional service across the industry.

As we expand, we strive to drive change in your teams, our industry and the world to create success stories with streamlined technology and solutions.

We are seeking a variety of talented individuals in UX UI Design. Please review the summary of the role and apply.

UX UI Designers ($98,000-$102,326.45 depending on level)

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

The Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) team plays a pivotal role in Affirm’s mission, building products that establish direct and lasting relationships with our customers. Our App and Card experiences empower people with transparent financing options wherever they need them, helping them make informed financial decisions with confidence.

As a Staff Product Designer, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of consumer finance at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey. This is one of the most impactful product areas, and you’ll have the full support of a deeply experienced and committed team to push boundaries, innovate, and create best-in-class experiences that redefine how people interact with their finances.

What You’ll Do



- Own and drive design initiatives for Affirm’s App and Card experience, delivering high-impact, customer-centric solutions that align with business objectives. 
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, data science, marketing, and research to drive innovation and deliver seamless, intuitive experiences. 
- Embrace agility—iterating quickly, adapting to change, and making data-driven decisions while maintaining a strong vision for the future. 
- Balance near-term execution with long-term strategic thinking, ensuring scalability and coherence across the Affirm ecosystem. 
- Push the envelope—challenge the status quo, think outside the box, and take calculated risks to drive meaningful innovation in financial products. 
- Bring exceptional visual and interaction design skills to craft delightful, polished experiences that build trust and confidence. 
- Champion a test-and-learn mindset, leveraging experimentation, research, and analytics to continuously refine and optimize user experiences. 

What We’re Looking For



- Proactive & Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments and take initiative to drive progress. 
- Strong Product Sense: You deeply understand user needs, business goals, and technical constraints—and can balance them effectively in your design decisions. 
- Data-Informed & Risk-Taking: You use data to guide your thinking but aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions and explore bold ideas. 
- Collaborative & Humble: You value diverse perspectives, work well with cross-functional partners, and are open to feedback to make the best decisions for our users. 
- Exceptional Craft & Visual Skills: You have a keen eye for detail, design systems, and interaction patterns that elevate user experiences. 
- Passion for Innovation: You’re excited about the challenge of designing financial products that improve people’s lives and want to push the industry forward.

title: Product Designer
description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

About The Role

Fluidstack is looking for a Product Designer who can own the end-to-end design of our products, both internal and external, from the first sketch to the last pixel shipped. This is a hands-on IC role, not a design strategy or oversight position. You will be the designer embedded with our product and engineering teams, shaping the interfaces that GPU cluster operators, AI platform engineers, and enterprise infrastructure teams interact with every day.

Our products are deeply technical and our developers and team members are power users, they are engineers and operators who work in terminals, read documentation compulsively, and have zero tolerance for UX that wastes their time. Designing for them requires genuine fluency in developer tools, infrastructure dashboards, and complex, data-dense interfaces. You need to know what great looks like in this space and be able to build it yourself.

You will work directly with PMs and engineers, as well as our customers, own design end-to-end for your product areas, and bring a strong visual sensibility that elevates everything you touch. If you have been waiting for a role where you can do your best work on genuinely hard UX problems, this is it.

You Will



- Own design end-to-end across research, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and shipped production UI.
- Design developer-facing products: cluster management dashboards, API consoles, job scheduling interfaces, resource utilization views, and alerting and observability surfaces.
- Write and maintain production-quality CSS and front-end markup in close collaboration with engineering, ensuring that what ships matches what was designed.
- Build and maintain a coherent design system: components and interaction patterns that scale across a growing product surface area.
- Conduct lightweight user research with technical audiences: structured interviews, usability sessions, and synthesis of feedback from customer interactions and support escalations.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Who We Are

Lab37 Robotics, is a technology company focused on the development and deployment of robots designed specifically for direct-to-customer food production. Our mission is to revolutionize the food industry by creating innovative robotic solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. We are passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver cutting-edge products that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll focus on our internal tools ecosystem for kitchen operations. Applications might include inventory tracking, recipe development, learning management systems, manager dashboards, performance metrics, robot user interfaces, and task scheduling. Translate complex user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into intuitive, high-quality, and scalable design solutions. Drive the design process from concept through launch, ensuring an optimal balance between user satisfaction, product performance, and engineering feasibility. You’ll build across multiple platforms and devices. Prototyping, testing, and iterating are part of our DNA and we expect that a successful candidate will have demonstrated experience using this process.

Responsibilities



- Build UI/UX for robotic systems: Design and refine user interfaces for on-robot displays, customer-facing applications, culinary brands, and internal operational tools, ensuring a cohesive and intuitive experience.
- Conduct User Research: Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative user research (e.g., interviews, usability testing) to gather deep user insights, validate design concepts, and ground the product roadmap in real-world user needs.
- Create Design Artifacts: Produce high-fidelity mockups, including working mockups rapidly created with generative AI tools, prototypes, detailed user flows, and clear specifications that clearly communicate design rationale and direction to engineering teams.
- Facilitate Cross-functional Execution and Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and users throughout the design lifecycle; proactively communicate trade-offs and drive consensus on design decisions.
- Leverage AI to supercharge how we design, sell, and support: Explore, design, and implement AI-powered solutions for our customers as well as internal tools for our design team. Our goal is to leverage AI to scale our business and make smarter, faster decisions.
- Maintain our design system: Contribute to, improve, and implement core components and patterns that support consistency across our products.

Qualifications



- 4+ years of UI/UX design experience

title: Vellox Product Designer
description:
Job Number: R0243056

Vellox Product Designer

The Opportunity:

Join Booz Allen as a Product Designer and help shape intuitive, polished experiences for a family of enterprise security and intelligence products. In this role, you will translate complex user needs, data-dense workflows, and technical requirements into production-ready interfaces that support security professionals and analysts working in high-stakes environments.

You’ll partner closely with product managers and engineers to move from concept to shipped outcomes, using strong design judgment, front-end code fluency, and a bias for practical delivery. Your work will support a product transition from traditional workflow-first interfaces toward AI-native and agentic interaction models, including conversational UX, assisted decisioning, and workflow automation. You’ll also contribute to a shared design system across the product suite, helping define the component patterns, visual standards, and design decisions that serve as the foundation for scalable product delivery.

- Design intuitive and elegant interfaces that balance visual craft, usability, and implementation feasibility across data-dense enterprise products.
- Create wireframes, high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes, and production-ready specifications that clearly communicate design intent.
- Design AI-native and agentic interaction patterns, including conversational interfaces, multi-step assisted flows, and AI-driven task orchestration.
- Translate product requirements and user needs into clear, compelling design solutions that support clarity, speed, and precision for security and analyst users.
- Partner with product managers and engineers throughout discovery, design, implementation, launch, and post-release iteration.

- Contribute to and govern a shared design system, including token architecture, component specifications, visual standards, and design decision records.

- Iterate rapidly based on stakeholder feedback, usage signals, and recurring design critique.

- 3+ years of experience in UX, UI, product design, or digital product design

- Experience using Figma, including components, auto layout, variables, and prototyping

OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Klarity to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch.

We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission.

About The Role

Klarity is at an inflection point. We're looking for a Staff Product Designer — a senior individual contributor who acts as a force multiplier across Klarity's product. You'll lead multiple complex, ambiguous design efforts end to end, set the bar for craft and for how design and code work together, and shape how our AI-native enterprise product holds together as one coherent system. Designer first, you bring your designs to life in working prototypes and into the product itself, with engineering alongside you.

We care about your systems thinking, and your track record of shipping — not your degree.

Enterprise software has a reputation for being clunky and hard to trust. Our bet is the opposite: that the most powerful Enterprise AI product can also be the most intuitive. Design is how we win that bet.

How Design Works At Klarity

Design at Klarity is small but mighty, and hands-on. We work in tight loops with engineering and product — no throwing mocks over a wall. Designers own problems end to end and bring their own work to life: you'll prototype with AI tools or in code and help ship the real thing, not just a spec. We care deeply about craft — the states, the edge cases, and the small details that make a product feel finished — and we'd rather get something in front of users and iterate than polish in private. And because AI is the core of what we build, designing for it is the job here, not a side specialty.

What You’ll Do



- Own a product area end to end — Take end-to-end ownership of a product area: lead its complex, strategic design problems from problem definition through a real, shipped experience. 
- Set the systems vision — Hold the whole product in view and keep it coherent as one experience as it scales — how flows, data, and product areas fit together — anticipating cross-area collisions and designing for them before they happen. 
- Define how design and code work together — Bring your designs into the product (with engineering alongside you), use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) fluently, and establish the prototyping and shipping practices the team adopts. 
- Own AI-native UX patterns — Own end-to-end UX for AI-native and agent

About Us

We are a small early-stage (pre-Series A) startup building AI-powered software for clinical research teams at academic medical centers. We turn dense, unstructured trial protocols into structured, usable data, so the people running studies spend less time wrangling documents and more time on the work that matters.

The Role

We need someone who can sit between dense, technical clinical-trial workflows and the people who use them every day, and make the complicated feel obvious. High autonomy, high ownership, low process. You will have real influence over the product, not a backlog of pixel-pushing tickets.

Why this role exists

We build software for clinical research teams at academic medical centers. The problems we solve are genuinely hard: turning long, unstructured protocol documents into structured data and usable interfaces that coordinators rely on for high-stakes, detail-heavy work.

Our team is strong on the systems side. We think logically, algorithmically, and we build robust pipelines and data models. What we are missing is a design-first voice: someone whose instinct is to start with the user, question complexity, and relentlessly simplify. - Establish and grow our design system: tokens, components, patterns, and the documentation that keeps them consistent.
- Be the advocate for the user in a room full of engineers who naturally think in systems and edge cases. Push back, propose alternatives, and explain the "why" behind design choices.
- Partner closely with backend and platform engineers so the experience and the data model serve each other.

Who You Are



- You start from the user, not the feature list. When you see complexity, your first question is whether the user should ever have to see it.

- You communicate design decisions clearly to a technical audience and welcome being challenged on them.

Virtuox, a Resmed company | Full-Time


Virtuox is an Independent Diagnostic Testing Facility and a Resmed company. We help patients complete diagnostic testing from home, including sleep apnea, cardiac arrhythmia, and hypoxemia testing. A physician orders a test, we ship a device directly to the patient, the patient completes the study, results are interpreted, and the report is returned to the ordering provider so they can take action. The experience may sound simple. The operational and clinical complexity behind it is not.

Virtuox operates across multiple test types, each with its own workflow, device, clinical protocol, operational dependency, and regulatory requirement. We are building the technology to make diagnostic testing faster, more automated, more observable, and more scalable.

This is not a role where design happens in isolation. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, CX, Clinical, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to move from ambiguous problems to shippable solutions. You will help define how complex diagnostic workflows become easier to understand, faster to complete, and more reliable at scale.

You will also work in an AI-native product development environment. That means using AI tools to accelerate exploration, synthesis, prototyping, content iteration, documentation with detailed context, and design decision-making while maintaining strong UX judgment, accessibility standards, and implementation quality.

We value designers who build trust before they build screens, think in systems rather than isolated pages, and care about measurable impact as much as polished output.
